# Tushar Kanti Dey - Full Stack Developer & DevOps Engineer

> Personal portfolio and engineering blog of Tushar Kanti Dey

## Introduction

Tushar Kanti Dey is a Full Stack Developer and DevOps Engineer based in Kolkata, India. He builds production-grade web applications with modern JavaScript frameworks and scalable cloud infrastructure.

## About Tushar Kanti Dey

Tushar Kanti Dey approaches software as a complete system, not a collection of features. From user interface to cloud infrastructure, every layer is intentional, predictable, and built to scale.

As a Full Stack Developer specializing in Next.js and React, Tushar builds performant web applications with TypeScript, Node.js, and modern JavaScript frameworks that serve real users in production.

On the DevOps side, Tushar Kanti Dey designs CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments with Docker and Kubernetes, and implements observability solutions to ensure systems remain reliable under load.

Currently studying at Adamas University in Kolkata, India, Tushar balances academics with building open-source projects and contributing to the developer community.

## Technical Skills

### Frontend Development
- **Frameworks**: Next.js 15+, React 19, Vue.js
- **Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS, CSS-in-JS, Framer Motion
- **State Management**: Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query

### Backend Development
- **Runtime**: Node.js, Bun
- **Frameworks**: Express.js, Fastify, NestJS
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase
- **ORMs**: Prisma, Drizzle, Mongoose

### DevOps & Infrastructure
- **Containerization**: Docker, Kubernetes
- **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins
- **Cloud Platforms**: AWS, Google Cloud, Vercel, Railway
- **Monitoring**: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog

### Tools & Practices
- **Version Control**: Git, GitHub
- **Testing**: Jest, Vitest, Playwright, Cypress
- **API Design**: REST, GraphQL, tRPC
- **Documentation**: OpenAPI, Swagger
